name: Nullex-ZT
description: A quantum-assembled titanium-iridium-boron lattice engineered at the atomic level to exhibit precisely zero coefficient of thermal expansion across a verified range of -270°C to 1,800°C. Nullex-ZT achieves this by incorporating opposing phononic structures that cancel thermal displacement vectors in all three axes simultaneously. Used wherever dimensional stability is non-negotiable — precision optics, orbital docking mechanisms, and quantum computing housings where micron-level drift is catastrophic.
story_hooks: A Nullex-ZT component from a destroyed orbital station has drifted into the lower tiers — it's dimensionally perfect for a weapon modification that would make the resulting firearm terrifyingly accurate, and multiple factions want it.

Crucible Industries is quietly recalling a specific production batch of Nullex-ZT after discovering the atomic lattice contains a subtle flaw that causes catastrophic shattering at a specific resonant frequency — a frequency a particular street musician has been hitting nightly.
A forger claims to have cracked Nullex-ZT synthesis using salvaged nano-assemblers — the knockoff holds dimensional stability, but nobody knows what it does at the temperature extremes.
